F1 is unmet as measured. The guard itself is in the right place. realizeNativeWorkspaceWork (implementation/native_workspace_work.ts:33-44) projects the exact-prefix environment, then calls checkWorksiteWriteRoots (worksite_operations.ts:995-1016) before observation and prepareAssembly. That check reuses worksiteReadRoots/plannedCanonicalPath, checkedWorksitePath, constructWorksiteTerritory and the new protectedWorksiteWriteRoot (worksite_effect.ts:520), and returns existing refusal codes. It has no schema or failure-class change. Reading the code, it covers exact, inside and enclosing overlap on the path reading for binding roots and on the physical reading for binding and install roots. Links are refused, and prefix siblings are not treated as contained because containsPath/confined use relative paths. The refusal cases ran before the failure and passed: binding and install exact/enclosing/inside, mixed W, and three link aliases. Each refused with port stage 'preparation'/'thrown' and zero assemblies, so before any provider dispatch. Direct realize also admitted ordinary W outside R (line 335 passed). However, the new required case 'protected write roots refuse…' fails at test_env/tests/t287-native-workspace-work.test.mjs:336 for 'W outside R': port expected 'prepared_probabilistic_leaf_owner_invocation', got 'closed_leaf_owner_receipt' (focused stdout, observation 0e89b1e2…). The port's isPreparedProbabilisticLeafInvocation (leaf_invocation_port.ts:392-418) requires the exact 11-field PROBABILISTIC_WORKER_REQUEST_FIELDS set, so it returns undispatched malformed_preparation. This is a defect in a test case attempt014 added, not evidence that production refuses W outside R. I found it by reading the code and did not reproduce it.
